# Optional slash commands

Two shortcuts for people who want a menu. The short ask is the same job and stays the paved path.

| Command | Ask it replaces |
|---------|-----------------|
| `sync` | *Update the doc templates from Agentic Doc Templates and sync our live docs.* |
| `orchestrate` | *Orchestrate — clear ready TODOs until blocked.* |

Installed only when `optional_rules.slash-commands` is `enabled`. Each `tools/<key>.md` says where the files go. A tool with no command folder still records the choice; the short ask is the path there.

Do not add more commands here. Do not paste playbook bodies into these files.
